shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md && printf '\\nFILES\\n' && rg --files | rg '(test|spec|package.json|test-commands|chatOrchestrator)' | head -200 && printf '\\nCONFIG\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml 2>/dev/null || true && printf '\\nSTATUS\\n' && git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts && sed -n '1,300p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && rg -n \"specs/.+#|spec:\" src scripts --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80 && ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true && ls -la .lore"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'rg -n "specs/[''^"]+#|spec anchor|@spec|spec:" src --glob '"'*.test.ts' && sed -n '1,180p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && rg -n \"anchor\" scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs | head -80 && git log -8 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.*#|spec anchor|@spec|spec:' src --glob '*.test.ts' || true
sed -n '1,220p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs
rg -n 'anchor' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs | head -80
git log -8 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/providers/mock/mockProvider.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/providers/mock/mockProvider.test.ts
sed -n '1,120p' src/types/session.ts
rg -n 'class PromptBuilder|constructor' src/infrastructure/builders/promptBuilder.ts
ls -la | sed -n '1,120p'
rg -n 'repoint-spec|reanchor' package.json scripts | head -40"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md
node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs origin/main
npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
git diff --check
git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
git status --short'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,180p' .lore/dod.md
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts
git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/beforeSessionFailure.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
git commit -m 'test(orchestrator): define failed startup hooks'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
